records.note: Pins public ACME issuance for this name to the listed public issuers (spec §24.8).

prerequisites: No CAA record names the Fleet CA: CAA constrains publicly trusted issuers only, and a private CA is neither a CAA checker nor bound by CAA (spec §24.8). CAA records appear only for names that also take public ACME certificates.

The zone is DNSSEC-signed and the signing is maintained: a TLSA record in an unsigned zone is a hint any on-path attacker can rewrite, so these records stay proposed until a DNSSEC-validating read-back proves them (contract §4, §5).
This change-set is a proposal produced offline; nothing was queried or written to live DNS. Applying it is a production-gated step (#9155).
